facts.detail: The consultation closed on 5 February 2026.
The page records the status as a published and closed statement.
The statement page was last updated on 20 March 2026.
Ofcom published the statement on 20 March 2026.
The plan outlines Ofcom's work for the next financial year.
Priorities are based on the Three Year Plan 2025-2028.
One priority is internet and post people can rely on.
One priority is media people trust and value.
One priority is enabling a safer life online.
One priority is enabling wireless in the UK economy, supported by an interactive project annex.

guard_streams.source: BDUK Vouchers Evaluation: Impacts and Value for Money Assessment
guard_streams.write_limit: Historic programme evaluation, survey and counterfactual findings do not establish current coverage, live orderability or measured speed for a selected parcel.

facts.detail: The evaluation page was published on 20 September 2023.
Hatch, Belmana and Winning Moves were appointed for the evaluation.
The evaluated product comprised GBVS and the Rural Gigabit Connectivity programme.
This was the second initial impact evaluation report.
The report examined vouchers issued and connected by March 2021.
It updated counterfactual analysis of technology availability and download speeds.
It analysed additional firm-level and area-level economic impacts.
It analysed a 2022 residential beneficiary survey.
It assessed household wellbeing and environmental impacts.
It included an initial cost-benefit and value-for-money assessment.
